blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — After hiding behind a trail of aliases to outrun the law, a 22-year-old woman was arrested for alleged estafa in a joint police operation in Cabadbaran City, Agusan del Norte on Sunday. Lt. Col. Edsel Montero Caramonte, Cabadbaran police chief, identified the suspect as Khrystel Jade Brongcano, also known as Khrystel Jade B. Lindio, a resident of Purok 3, Barangay 3, Cabadbaran City. Caramonte said the suspect was arrested by virtue of an arrest warrant issued by acting Cebu Presiding Judge Kathleen Llenares Cezar of the Municipal Trial Court in Cities, 10th Judicial Region, issued […]...
